crossRefs.note: Of Benjamin: Abidan the son of Gideoni.
On the ninth day Abidan the son of Gideoni, prince of the children of Benjamin,
and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year…
Abidan the son of Gideoni was over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin.

people.name: Abidan

translations.web: “The tribe of Benjamin: the prince of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.
translations.bsb: Next will be the tribe of Benjamin. The leader of the Benjamites is Abidan son of Gideoni,
translations.kjv: Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.
